title: Shift 0.05 of scoring weight from sentiment to fundamental
why: sentiment has agreed with actual price direction 32% of the time over 28 measured calls, vs. fundamental's 70% over 23.
effect: Confidence scores lean slightly more on fundamental and less on sentiment.

title: Keep recommendations approvable for 3h instead of 2h
why: 34 actionable recommendations over the last 30 days expired with no decision recorded.
effect: More time to approve or reject from the email before a recommendation lapses.
risk: An older approval can still execute; the stale-price re-check at submission is what limits how far the market can have moved.
